column16: 💧 One of Nepal’s largest glacial lakes formed from the melt of the Trakarding and Drolambu glaciers. 🏔️ Nestled between the Gaurishankar and Rolwaling Himal ranges, offering dramatic alpine scenery. 🔭 Panoramic views of towering peaks like Gaurishankar (7,134m), Melungtse (7,181m) and Rolwaling peaks. 🕉️ Rich cultural encounters with Sherpa and Tamang communities in Simigaun, Beding and Na. 🏕️ Camping experience at the lake — perfect for adventurous trekkers. 🐐 Wildlife sightings possible: musk deer, Himalayan tahr, langur monkeys and mountain birds. ❄️ Spectacular glacier views and icy waters with turquoise color on sunny days
column17: Tsho Rolpa is one of Nepals largest glacial lakes formed by the melting Trakarding Glacier and is known for its turquoise waters and risk of glacial outburst floods.

column16: 🗻 Thorong La Pass (5,416m): One of the highest trekking passes in the world. 🌄 Breathtaking Views: Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre, Manaslu. 🏡 Cultural Villages: Experience Gurung, Thakali and Manangi lifestyles. 🛕 Spiritual Sites: Visit Muktinath Temple and Buddhist monasteries. 💦 Hot Springs: Relax at Tatopani’s natural hot spring. 🏞️ Varied Landscapes: Lush valleys to high-altitude deserts.
column17: The Annapurna Circuit passes through diverse landscapes-from lush subtropical valleys to high alpine terrain-crossing the Thorong La Pass along with rich cultural experiences.
